model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.54 m, eave 3.64 m, ridge 6.82 m above the ground

by the hall kit: 3 bays, the middle widest, a porch front and back, steps on the back, front, 硬山 flush gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

searched: This block has no name on the plan or in the texts, so no source can be searched for it by name.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01) with no label, 3x1 cells: a building stood here, its name unknown.
